messages:
alex: FYI — got secops-bot alert: spike in KMS Decrypts for service-account-prod at ~03:12 UTC. anyone oncall?
secops-bot: Alert triggered: unusual_kms_decrypt_rate
```
alert_id: A-20260315-01
resource: projects/redwood-prod/cryptoKeys/sa-prod-key
count: 1,200 in 5m
threshold: 300
```
jamal: Taking command. @olivia please stand by for infra checks, @maria on RBAC. I'll do initial triage.
olivia: Fetching KMS audit logs now, pulling last 200 decrypt events.
emily: I can correlate with egress logs if needed.
jamal: Early look — decrypts originate from two internal IPs 10.45.22.9 and 10.45.22.11 and all use service-account-prod. Sample log:
```
protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="service-account-prod@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
sourceIP="10.45.22.9"
```
maria: If it's an app compromise we should rotate keys and remove roles. Proposing: 1) remove roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter from SA 2) disable SA keys 3) rotate key material 4) run forensics.
jamal: Agreed. Implementing step 1 now: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member="serviceAccount:service-account-prod@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"`
olivia: Removed binding and disabled short-lived tokens on the app side. Confirmed some decrypt attempts still in logs but failing with PERMISSION_DENIED now.
emily: No outbound egress spikes to external IPs in the window. Looks internal only so far.
jamal: Opening incident: INC-2026-042 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-042). Severity P2 for now. No customer-visible downtime.
maria: I'll prepare a follow-up RBAC ticket to re-evaluate least-privilege for app workflows: TKT-SEC-249.
jamal: For handoff in ~30m to @olivia: timeline + artifacts below.
Timeline:
- 03:12 UTC alert raised by secops-bot
- 03:14 UTC jamal assumed command
- 03:18 UTC identified IPs and SA
- 03:25 UTC removed KMS role from SA
- 03:28 UTC disabled SA keys; decrypts failing
Artifacts:
- exported logs: gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-042/logs.tar.gz
- packet captures: wip (internal only)
Action items:
- olivia: continue forensic collection, validate if any lateral movement
- emily: confirm no external egress and review app-side tokens
- maria: run RBAC audit and propose permanent mitigations
- jamal: draft post-incident summary once contained

handing off to olivia. take it from here, I'll be offline for the next hour. :thumbsup:
olivia: Taking the lead. Acknowledged timeline and tasks. Will post updates in this thread. Starting forensic snapshot now.
secops-bot: Note: automated re-check scheduled in 10m.
